sources.name: UK Government Lunchbox Recipes
sources.description: 9 school lunchbox recipes with full macronutrient profiles and EU FIC allergen tags, developed for UK primary school packed lunches.
sources.contents: 9 recipes: allergen tags, full nutrition per serving (kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, protein, salt), diet tags, preparation methods.

sources.name: PACK-IT Cookbook: PAcking Complete Lunches for KIds Together
sources.description: 20 recipes for school packed lunches designed to meet MyPlate standards. Developed by Virginia Cooperative Extension, funded by USDA SNAP-Ed.
sources.publisher: Virginia Cooperative Extension / Virginia Tech / Virginia State University
sources.author: Alisha Farris, PhD, RDN
sources.licence: Public Domain (US Government / USDA SNAP-Ed funded). Free to reproduce with attribution.
sources.access_conditions: Freely accessible. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) is an equal opportunity provider and employer.
sources.citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). PACK-IT Cookbook. Virginia Cooperative Extension. Virginia Tech and Virginia State University.
sources.contents: 20 recipes across 4 weeks: full ingredient lists, nutrition facts panels (calories, fat, sodium, carbohydrates, protein, calcium, iron, potassium), lunch cost per serving, preparation time, food safety guidance.

sources.name: 75 Healthy Lunch Ideas for Kids
sources.description: Meal combination ideas referencing healthy lunchbox components. Note: specific recipes reference the proprietary FIXATE Cooking Show (Beachbody) and are not reproduced; only the general meal structure and ingredient categories are used.
sources.licence: Proprietary — individual meal components (fruits, vegetables, proteins, grains) referenced by ingredient category only, not verbatim recipe reproduction.
sources.access_conditions: Proprietary content. Used here only for general healthy lunchbox meal category guidance, not for verbatim recipe reproduction.
sources.contents: 75 meal combination ideas across 10 categories: sandwiches, pastas, pizzas, breakfast, eggs, soups, wraps, salads, miscellaneous, recipes.

sources.name: EU FIC / UK Food Information Regulations — 14 Declarable Allergens
sources.description: Legal reference for the 14 allergens requiring mandatory declaration under EU Regulation 1169/2011 (retained in UK law post-Brexit as the Food Information Regulations 2014).
sources.contents: 14 allergen definitions, school/caterer duty-of-care obligations, key facts on allergen prevalence in children.

sources.name: Government Dietary Recommendations — Energy and Nutrients for Children
sources.description: Age-banded dietary reference values for children aged 4–18, used to set per-lunch sugar/salt/energy ceilings in guardrails.py.
sources.contents: EAR/RNI/LRNI values for energy, macronutrients, vitamins, minerals by sex and age band (4-6, 7-10, 11-14, 15-18 years).

sources.name: The Eatwell Guide
sources.description: UK Government healthy eating guidelines used to structure lunchbox nutritional rationale in the generation layer.
sources.contents: Food group proportions, portion guidance, practical lunchbox application tips for each food group.
